source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
When you gather a **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon's **[attack dice](vsdata:core-rule/resolve-attacks)**, add 1 die per 5 models the target unit had at the [Select Targets](vsdata:core-rule/select-targets) step, rounded down; a **[[BLAST X]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon adds X dice per 5 models instead.

This rule (24.05) sets no engagement limit, but:

- **[Close-Quarters Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)** (10.06) stops a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** model's **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** attacks against units **engaged** with its own unit.
- No **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon can target an **[engaged MONSTER or VEHICLE unit](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-at-engaged-monsters-and-vehicles)**.

engagementElsewhere.scope: MONSTER or VEHICLE models using Close-Quarters Shooting
engagementElsewhere.rule: [BLAST] attacks cannot target a unit engaged with the firing unit

engagementElsewhere.source: FAQ p88 and p63 diagram caption
engagementElsewhere.scope: any unit shooting an engaged MONSTER or VEHICLE unit
